segments.an10.196:1.1: “Bahulīkātabbañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desessāmi na bahulīkātabbañca.
segments.an10.196:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, na bahulīkātabbo dhammo?
segments.an10.196:1.4: Pāṇātipāto … pe … micchādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, na bahulīkātabbo dhammo.
segments.an10.196:2.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī … pe … sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahulīkātabbo dhammo”ti.
